picked.title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
picked.summary: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. Furthermore, we release 40 hours of UMI-Live data across three tasks, and complete hardware designs, software, and reproduction guides at our $\href{https://umi-live.github.io/}{\text{project website}}$.

picked.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
picked.summary: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.

picked.title: Quantize by Doing: Task-Guided Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
picked.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but lowering bit widths while maintaining task performance remains challenging. Existing work has used sensitivity estimates from calibration data to assign bit widths to different model components. However, using task success directly to guide mixed-precision allocation is underexplored because closed-loop evaluations are costly and the effect of quantizing one component depends on the precision of other components. To this end, we propose \textbf{QbD-VLA}, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method that uses task success from short closed-loop evaluations to assign weight and activation bit widths while accounting for interactions between model components. Experiments covering four VLA models and all four LIBERO suites show strong task performance at average precisions of approximately 4 bits for weights and fewer than 6 bits for activations. On SIMPLER, the gain over uniform quantization is small. On a Franka Research 3 robot arm, simulation-selected allocations show no detected success-rate loss on X-VLA but fail on $π_{0.5}$. These findings support using task success to guide mixed-precision VLA quantization, while highlighting the need for real-world evaluation before deployment. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}{\texttt{github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}}.

picked.title: Robotic Data Inoculation
picked.summary: Modern robot learning systems feed on high-quality demonstration data, and their performance hinges on coverage. Without good coverage, small errors compound and the policy can quickly go into out-of-distribution states from which it cannot recover. Yet there is no principled way of collecting high-coverage data, and data collection often relies on heuristic instructions to human operators. Purely online reinforcement learning (RL) explores at the cost of safety and sample efficiency, while DAgger-style interventions require the policy to fail by chance before a human can correct it. In this paper, we ask instead whether we can modify how the robot behaves during data collection to collect more useful data. We propose Data Inoculation (DI), a shared-control framework in which a human provide closed-loop teleoperation commands while a residual policy perturbs these commands. The residual policy is trained online, on the growing dataset, with the same reward-maximizing objective later used for policy extraction, so its perturbations steer data collection toward the deviations a policy trained on the data would make. These perturbations expose the robot to a wider range of states, while the human's continuous corrections provide recovery demonstrations, "inoculating" the dataset against the learner's future mistakes while the human remains in control. On three challenging real-world robotic tasks, DI consistently improves or matches the success rate of policies trained with both behavioral cloning and offline RL, showing DI as an effective data collection strategy for improving downstream policy performance.

picked.title: 李飞飞挖的三个「坑」：从 ImageNet 到空间智能，这一次她会怎么填？
picked.summary: 82 亿美元，已经为整个世界模型赛道提供了价值锚点。82亿美元，全股票收购李飞飞创立的 World Labs。 这是 AMD 史上第二大收购，仅次于 2022 年以约 500 亿美元拿下赛灵思。 赛灵思是30多年的老牌芯片公司，而 World Labs，仅仅成立两年。 这一消息发出后，圈内人士的第一反应很一致：苏姿丰在对标英伟达的 Cosmos 和机器人平台，买人、买模型洞察力、买一张通往物理AI时代的入场券。 但苏姿丰不是这笔交易里唯一在下注的人。 李飞飞也在下注。而且她押上的，是自己的下一个二十年。 过去二十年，她反复在做同一件事：在每一个技术拐点，先一步定义“什么是值得做的下一件事”。 但前两次，她只负责出题，把答题的活儿交给别人。而这一次，她把自己按在了答题席上。 01 三次“挖坑”，有何不同？ 被誉为“AI 教母”的李飞飞，圈内人对她印象最深的，或许是她最擅长“挖坑”（出题）。过去二十年，她挖的三个最关键的坑：ImageNet、AI 民主化、空间智能。 单独看每一个，都是对 AI 行业走向的一次精准判断。但摆在一起看，她扮演的角色截然不同。 ▎ 第一个“坑”：纯出题，整个深度学习社区答题 2007年前后，李飞飞在普林斯顿做助理教授。计算机视觉领域当时最要命的问题是泛化——算法在实验室里跑得通，出了门就失灵。大多数人选择改进算法，李飞飞选了另一条路：造数据。 …

picked.title: IROS 2026 观察：从 Demo 到生产力工具，灵巧手还要跨过几道坎？
picked.summary: 灵巧手的设计逻辑，要由落地需求反推。 作者丨向 欣 编辑丨高景辉 今年 IROS，灵巧操作和触觉的热度比以往更盛，串珠子、插 USB、给帆布袋烫 logo、手内转笔、转球、调酒，各种演示在现场轮番上演。 从 ICRA，到 WRC，再到 IROS，我们追踪了今年几乎所有机器人领域的顶会，一个越来越清晰的感受是：对灵巧手而言，完成复杂动作已经越来越不是难事。 展示不再局限于简单的抓取和搬运，变得更强调 复杂接触（contact-rich）、动态调整、长时序操作 以及 可变形物体处理 等接近真实作业的任务。 整体来看，厂商对落地的需求越来越高，心态也更加务实。过去大家追求参数丰富、指标极致，如今 不少参数反而开始回 调，有的是自由度做了减法，有的是传感器配置更加务实。 长期可靠 性、稳定使用、易维护，以及交付后能否真正用起来被放到更优先的位置。 这也是今年我们在源升智能展台看到的一个有意思的变化。 IROS现场，源升智能的高自由度五指灵巧手Apex Hand展示了一组侧重点不同的操作任务：基于强化学习的手内转球、灵巧手把脉、全掌触觉实时感知、持续高负载恒温抓握，以及劈裂木板、钉钉子等高冲击操作。 这些Demo展示了Apex Hand在 复杂接触、动态调整、长时序操作和高冲击场景下 的综合能力，它已经能完成足够复杂的动作，甚至在某些维度上超出了常规抓取搬运的范畴。 但这些能力要如何从展台走向真实作业，并被客户持续用起来？一只面向真实应用的灵巧手，究竟需要具备怎样的综合能力？ …

picked.title: 宇树最新财报：重金投入研发，上市后的考题变了
picked.summary: 雷峰网 10月28日晚，宇树披露上市后的首份三季报。2026年前三季度，营收已经超过2025全年，公司实现营收18.17亿元，但毛利率明显回落，研发费用率大幅抬升，扣非利润实际下滑。 宇树的收入还在加速增长，利润却没有跟上。 不过，表面看，这是一份“增收不增利”的财报。实质上，这是宇树主动用过去两年赚到的硬件红利，去补贴具身大模型和算力投入的战略换挡。短期利润与现金流承压，是换挡的必然代价。 01 从财报看宇树 收入增长，利润承压，研发加码 本次三季报最值得关注的信息，可以归纳为三个核心结论。 结论一：营收仍在高速增长，但已从爆发式增长转向稳定放量，各产品线收入不透明了。 宇树科技2026年前三季度营业收入18.17亿元，同比增长55.7%；第三季度单季营收6.65亿元，同比增长69.9%。前三季度营收已经超过2025年全年的16.99亿元。 这些数据说明公司业务规模仍在快速扩张，收入继续上台阶。但同比增速从2025年的332.7%，回落到前三季度的55.7%。 不过，这属于典型的高基数下的稳态增长，并不是衰退。 把视角拉到更长周期看，2023年宇树科技营收仅1.59亿元，2024年增至3.93亿元（+146.8%），2025年飙升至16.99亿元（+332.7%）。 2024～2025这两年是人形机器人从几乎为零快速放量的渗透红利期。2026年增速回落，是基数抬高后的正常现象，也意味着公司正从“新品红利”进入“规模化运营”阶段。 宇树科技在这次财报中，将营业收入的增长归因为 产品创新与业务拓展 …
